newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France August cargo traffic up 8.4pct.
newsitem.headline: Air France August cargo traffic up 8.4pct.

text.p: Air France said its global cargo traffic, expressed in freight-tonne-kilometres, FTK, last month, was up 8.4 percent on August 1995 at 382.2 million FTK.
Overall cargo load factor in August 1996 was up 2.9 percent on the same month last year at 65.0 percent, the airline added.
In the first five months of its current financial year (April 1 1996-March 31 1997), Air France transported 1.96 billion FTK, up 5.5 percent on April-August 1995, the airline said.
Cargo load factor for April-August 1996 was stable on the previous year at 66.2 percent, Air France added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
